meta.name: agentspace
meta.description: See what your AI agent is doing, from anywhere. The agent keeps writing — logs, code, generated outputs, screenshots, artifacts. One command turns the folder into a live URL you (or a teammate) open in any browser to watch files evolve, edit in place, or comment — no sync, no zip, no account. Workspaces stay live 24 hours anonymously; one email claim keeps them permanent. Hosted on Cloudflare. Triggers on "show me what the agent is doing", "open the agent's folder", "share this folder", "give me a link", "hand off this workspace", or any ask to make an agent's local file state visible from another device or to another person.

copy.tagline: 把AI agent的工作文件夹实时分享为可浏览的网页链接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让队友或自己从任何设备实时查看agent的产出文件。
copy.tagline_en: Share your AI agent's working folder as a live browsable URL
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want teammates or yourself to view agent output files in real time from any device.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以把你的本地文件夹或文件变成一个公开的网页链接。你或别人打开链接就能看到文件内容、在线编辑或评论，不需要注册账号。
howto.when: 当你说“看看我的文件夹”、“分享这个文件夹”、“给我一个链接”或类似的话时，Claude 会询问要分享哪个路径，然后执行命令生成链接。

say.text: 分享当前文件夹给我看看。
把这个日志文件分享给同事。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个只读链接，你可以发给同事。

say.text: 给我一个链接，让我在手机上看看这个项目。
say.note: Claude 会分享文件夹，返回一个在手机上也能打开的链接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can turn your local folder or file into a public web link. You or others can open the link to view files, edit in place, or comment without signing up.
howto.when_en: When you say "show me the folder", "share this folder", "give me a link", or similar, Claude will ask which path to share and run the command to generate a link.

say_en.text: Share the current folder with me.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the path and generate an editable link.

say_en.text: Share this log file with my colleague.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a view-only link for sharing.

say_en.text: Give me a link to see this project on my phone.
say_en.note: Claude will share the folder and return a mobile-friendly link.
